entities.summary: Pietro Aurino is a retired male boxer from Italy. Nicknamed The Killer he represented his native country at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia, where he was stopped in the second round of the men's light-heavyweight division by Kazakhstan's eventual gold medalist Vassili Jirov. He challenged once for the WBO world cruiserweight title in 2000. Pietro Aurino was a athletes & competitors from Torre Annunziata (b. 1976-11-16, Torre Annunziata). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
